facts.value: Business French 1 - Foundation
Completion of Level A2/B1 of the GER or 30-50 points in the placement test.

In the Business French 1 - Foundation course, you will learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world. You will gain extensive knowledge of the French language and insights into the country, its society, and topics relevant to business such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends.
Maximum of 20 participants.
Oral participation and presentation, written examination in the last week of lectures. A graded certificate will be issued for passing the examinations.
Business French 1 - Foundation (13 double hours, including final exam): 90 Euros.
Business French 2 - Consolidation
Completion of Level B1 of the GER or 50-75 points in the placement test.

In the Business French 2 - Consolidation course, you will learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world. You will gain extensive knowledge of the French language and insights into the country, its society, and topics relevant to business such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends.
Maximum of 20 participants.
Oral participation and presentation, written examination in the last week of lectures. A graded certificate will be issued for passing the examinations.
Business French 2 - Consolidation (13 double hours, including final exam): 90 Euros. This course is only offered in the winter semester.
Business French 3 - Advanced
Completion of Level B2.1 of the GER or at least 75 points in the placement test.

In the Business French 3 - Advanced course, you will learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world. You will gain extensive knowledge of the French language and insights into the country, its society, and topics relevant to business such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends.
Maximum of 20 participants.
Oral participation and presentation, written examination in the last week of lectures. A graded certificate will be issued for passing the examinations.
Business French 3 - Advanced (13 double hours, including final exam): 90 Euros. This course is only offered in the summer semester.
